freshness_method: Guarded promotion must check exact target IDs against all canonical Urdu A1-B1 targets and any live B2 records immediately before append.

targets.intended_sense: mathematics; quantitative reasoning used to describe or compare patterns
consent; voluntary agreement after relevant information is understood
diesel fuel or diesel-powered transport in an emissions-policy context
growth or development, especially plant growth
superficial; based only on the most obvious layer without deeper examination
ethics; principles for judging responsible conduct
human; relating to people and human judgment, needs, or limits

generation_guardrails: B2 passage text should remain in the 350-550 whitespace-token production band.
Difficulty should come from argument structure, assumptions, counterarguments, scope, and synthesis rather than excessive new vocabulary.
P1-P5 introduce exactly two new lexical targets each; P6 introduces none and visibly recycles all ten.
Science-and-society scenarios are fictional or method-focused unless factual claims are independently sourced.
Public-health and ethics passages remain educational and do not provide individualized medical advice.
The consent scenario must distinguish voluntary participation from mere notification.
Generation/integrity status remains separate from educator/publication release approval.
freshness_scope: Exact target IDs checked against all canonical Urdu A1, A2, B1, and any live B2 records immediately before Unit 1 append.
